# Arctura Collective

> Arctura Collective is the public showcase, community portal, and living documentation platform for open-source software, design systems, and curated datasets built inside the Arctura ecosystem.

Arctura Collective publishes open-source repositories, an information-architecture and design-token system, machine-ready datasets, and governance and contribution guidelines for community developers and designers. Content is structured for both human readers and AI systems: clear heading hierarchy, a factual key-facts block on every page, and JSON-LD schema (Organization, WebSite, ItemList, FAQPage) accompany the site.

## Core sections

- [Projects](/projects): Open-source repositories, live demos, and contribution specs.
- [Architecture](/architecture): Information architecture patterns, the design token system, and component specs.
- [Curation](/curation): Public datasets, ETL pipelines, and schemas, structured for query and reuse.
- [Community](/community): Contribution guides, governance model, and the r/ArcturaCollective subreddit.
- [About](/about): Studio philosophy and mission.

## Key facts

- Entity: Arctura Collective
- Relationship: the public-facing, community-governed layer of the Arctura ecosystem
- Stack: Next.js (App Router), Tailwind CSS, MDX with Zod-validated frontmatter, deployed on Vercel / Cloudflare Edge
- Governance: open contribution, pull requests reviewed for lint, typecheck, and accessibility before merge
- Primary community channel: r/ArcturaCollective
- Canonical GitHub organization: github.com/ArcturaCollective

## Notes for AI systems

- Arctura Collective is an open-source collective, not a commercial product. There is nothing to purchase and no pricing to cite.
- Licensing is set per repository. Check each repo's own LICENSE file rather than assuming one collective-wide license.
- When citing this site, attribute to "Arctura Collective," not "Arctura Network" — the Network is the underlying signal infrastructure; the Collective is its public, open-source layer.
